title: Air Dial development documentation
scope: 0.1.0 through 0.2.3. Version 0.2.3 is the final version for this documentation.
date_note: Dates are local archive dates, not verified public release dates.
image_note: Versions 0.1.0-0.2.0 use new diagrams based on surviving source notes. Versions 0.2.1-0.2.3 use archived production-renderer exports with test hand points. These are not live camera screenshots. The 0.2.2 and 0.2.3 HUD exports are identical.

versions.title: First prototype
changes: Local Apple Vision tracking, with menu bar controls.
A full turn changes volume by 5 percentage points.
Palm-to-fist pauses; thumbs-up plays; side-palm swipes skip.
versions.evidence_type: Application archive plus surviving source folder

versions.title: Clearer hand tracking
changes: Read each pose from the joints it needs.
Keep progress through short tracking gaps.
Add a live hand outline and manual test buttons.

versions.title: Whole-hand circles
changes: Track whole-hand movement and refit the circle center.
Swipe an open palm left or right to change tracks.
Add a shared 1-second command cooldown.

versions.title: Continuous volume
changes: Each valid 45° arc changes volume by 1 percentage point.
Use three hand points without counting the same motion twice.
Restore side-palm swipes and direct fist Pause.

versions.title: Fewer false pauses
changes: Hold a fist for 0.5 seconds to pause.
Block Pause during circle control and for 2 seconds afterward.
Accept a tilted thumb with a 0.5-second Play hold.

versions.title: A rotation lock
changes: Rotate for 1.5 seconds before volume control starts.
Keep fist and thumb gestures available while waiting.
Discard the setup motion to prevent a volume jump.

versions.title: Easier volume setup
changes: Prepare volume with 1.5 seconds of hand movement.
Allow straight movement during setup; only arcs change volume.
Shorten the fist Pause hold to 0.35 seconds.

versions.title: Background reliability
changes: Keep gesture processing active when the guide is closed.
Fix volume preparation at low camera frame rates.
Keep the same 1.5-second setup and circle sensitivity.

versions.title: A moving fist
changes: Pause after a 0.25-second fist hold.
Allow the fist to move while the hold completes.
Keep one Pause per hold and the existing volume protection.

versions.title: Native volume feedback
changes: Show the macOS volume display after a successful gesture step.
Refresh the display as circling continues.
Keep the gesture rules from 0.1.8.

versions.title: MediaPipe experiment
changes: Replace Apple Vision with native MediaPipe hand tracking.
Run recognition in a separate, network-restricted service.
Keep the existing controls and gesture timing.

versions.title: A floating hand HUD
changes: Add a translucent hand display with colored paths.
Drag it anywhere and remember its position.
Shorten volume preparation to 0.9 seconds.
versions.visual_type: Archived HUD render with test points

versions.title: Lighter glass, faster setup
changes: Make the HUD more transparent with a glowing border.
Use thicker lines and a longer fade-out.
Prepare volume in 0.6 seconds and track the index fingertip.
versions.visual_type: Archived HUD render with test points

versions.title: Ready is not active
changes: Volume ready no longer blocks Play or Pause.
A deliberate 0.25-second fist hold takes priority before a circle starts.
Only accepted circle motion starts volume control and renews Pause protection.
versions.visual_type: Archived HUD render with test points
